blocks.text: VATICAN CITY — The late Pope Francis saw the devil three times and once saw the “gates of hell,” according to his personal diary, excerpts of which were published on Tuesday in a new book. “The Private Diary of Pope Francis,” by Argentine Cardinal Victor Manuel Fernandez, includes passages taken from a journal the former Jorge Bergoglio kept between 1992 and 2024, a document that reveals his worries, regrets and self-critiques—as well as his enormous humanity and faith. Fernandez, head of the Vatican’s Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith, said he was asked by Francis to help make known to […]...
